title: The Azure Mender's School Course
summary: A school course in the dual-track healing of the azure schools that ends in the opening of the mending bloom.

title: Manual of the Measured Physician's Rites
summary: A school manual of measured doses and solemn rites that ends in the paired resurgence of a physician's two hands.

title: The Twin River Healing Canon
summary: A school canon of two streams of healing qi that meet at one point and mend whatever lies where they join.

title: Treatise of the Hawk Dive and Mending Guard
summary: A school treatise that joins the plunging descent of the hawk with the brimming basin of qi in one great act of mercy.

title: Canon of the Highest Mending
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the highest mending of the azure schools and its final restoration.

title: The Wind-Sworn Healing Course
summary: A school course in the sworn healing of the Gale academies that ends in the great restoration of the wind-sworn.

title: Manual of the Plateau Oath Healer
summary: A school manual of the healing oath sworn on the plateau and kept through every long night of mending.

title: The Gale Bearing Healing Canon
summary: A school canon of mending on a held bearing in the gale that ends in the bearing that calls the failing back.

title: The Great Draw of Mercy
summary: A school text on the great draw of healing qi from the first drill to the unfettered gift of mercy.

title: Canon of the Oath Unbowed by Wind
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the oath no wind can bow and the renewal it grants.
